annotations.title: Prepare a FirmLedger Pro checkout link

description: Does NOT charge anything. Returns a personal link to FirmLedger's own checkout for the chosen Pro plan (optionally with a promo code). The user opens it, signs in, reviews the order on FirmLedger and pays on the secure Lemon Squeezy checkout themselves. You can never complete or confirm a payment and must never ask for card details; if the user says "yes, do it", give them the link again. Without an API key it returns the pricing page instead.

plan.description: The plan id from list_plans (or its exact name).

promo_code.description: Optional promo code the user gave you.

name: prepare_upgrade
